title: status and next do not see a task that was only created
desc:
In a fresh checkout, wb task new "fix login" --type bug prints next: wb task get WB-1, and then wb next says error: no work in progress in this checkout (exit 6) and wb status says no work in progress. status_lib.keys() only lists .workflow/<KEY>/ directories, and a task that has only been recorded in the local backlog has none. The first step a new user takes breaks the guided flow.

ACCEPTANCE:
- an open local task with no artifacts is listed by wb status, reported as not started with its backlog title
- wb next with no key picks it (after the branch, by recency) and says: wb task get <KEY>
- a done local task with no artifacts is not listed and never picked
- --stats counts it like any other ticket in the snapshot
- regression tests for each rule
